cohort: 50 patients with a history of severe adherent placentas at Bacha Khan Medical Complex from January 2020 to December 2022 (Group A: 15 patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy; Group B: 35 patients undergoing myometrial excision).
finding: Myometrial resection was associated with fewer complications (infection, blood loss, bladder injury, and re-laparotomy) compared to cesarean hysterectomy.
followup_time: Duration of postoperative hospital stay was recorded, but specific follow-up time is not mentioned.
